changes: GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/code/dashboards — the response property `results/dashboards/items/tiles/items/anyOf[#/components/schemas/DashboardComposerChartTileAsCode]/allOf[subschema #2]/properties/allOf[subschema #2]/chartSlug` became nullable for the status `200`

GET /api/v1/projects/{projectUuid}/dashboards/code — the response property `results/dashboards/items/tiles/items/anyOf[#/components/schemas/DashboardComposerChartTileAsCode]/allOf[subschema #2]/properties/allOf[subschema #2]/chartSlug` became nullable for the status `200`

declaredAdvisories.reason: The dashboard-as-code type now allows chartSlug: null on a composer chart tile, so the two dashboard download responses show that property as nullable. Only the schema widens: this release still leaves a composer tile whose chart is gone out of the download, so no response carries a null slug and an old CLI or an old server pod in a rolling update reads exactly what it read before.

impact.firstPartyOnly: The Lightdash CLI download is the only client of these dashboard-as-code endpoints, and this release never sends it a null composer chartSlug; the nullable type lets new CLIs and servers read such a tile before a later release writes one.
